name: PT Fortune Resources Investment Tbk
summary: PT Fortune Resources Investment Tbk engages in the mining and extraction of laterite nickel ore. The company provides mining contracting services to mining concession holders and holders of Izin Usaha Pertambangan (Mining Business Licenses) in the Luwuk area, Banggai Regency, Central Sulawesi. It offers overburden removal, involving stripping topsoil and cover layers using heavy equipment. The company also provides ore mining services, including the extraction of laterite nickel ore from the mining face.
